title: Chicken Kheema “Pulao”
method: Marinate your kheema with the spices mentioned in the caption and keep in the fridge for minimum 1 hour
Add the oil to a pan, followed by your dry spices and allow to gently cook
Add in the onions and dry masalas and stir for 5 minutes
Add in the tomatoes and cook that for 3-4 minutes till tomotoes are mushy
Add in the kheema to the mix and allow to cook evenly
While the kheema is cooking, make your rice and air fried onions
Cut the onions thinlu drizle with 1/2 tsp oil and air fryer till crispy, i like mine charred a bit :)
Once the kheema is done, turn the stove off and add in the dahi ( this keeps the kheema moist) and coriander leaves
Layer the mix in the pot and enjoy :)
caption:
Chicken Kheema “Pulao”

Nutrition: 
C: 69 | F: 18 | P: 37
Calories: 550 per serving 
Serves 3

chicken kheema marinade: 
450 grams chicken mince
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp haldi powder
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp jeera powder

1 tbsp oil
small cinnamon sticks
3 green cardamom
3 cloves
1-2 bay leafs
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 onion, finely chopped
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
2 tomatoes, finely chopped
1 tsp red chilli powder
1/2 tsp haldi powder
1 tsp garam masala
1/3 cup dahi
1/2 cup coriander leaves

150 grams basmati rice
saffron water
air fried onions
mint leaves for the layering and topping

Method: 
marinate your kheema with the spices mentioned in the caption and keep in the fridge for minimum 1 hour 
add the oil to a pan, followed by your dry spices and allow to gently cook
add in the onions and dry masalas and stir for 5 minutes 
add in the tomatoes and cook that for 3-4 minutes till tomotoes are mushy
add in the kheema to the mix and allow to cook evenly
while the kheema is cooking, make your rice and air fried onions
cut the onions thinlu drizle with 1/2 tsp oil and air fryer till crispy, i like mine charred a bit :)
once the kheema is done, turn the stove off and add in the dahi ( this keeps the kheema moist) and coriander leaves

layer the mix in the pot and enjoy :)
